en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a wooded area with a decorative wooden pavilion or shelter on the left and a tall Marian roadside shrine on the right. The shrine features a niche with an image or statue of the Virgin Mary and Child, set on an ornate pedestal surrounded by potted plants and flowers. A path or clearing runs between the structures, and large trees fill the background. The caption in red letters at the bottom reads "Karlsbad. Marienbild beim Aberg."
